# Partners, sponsors and media

Model: `partner-media-grid`. Each call creates a complete slide. Inter, geometry and text sizes are fixed.

[Model index](../../../templates/MODELS.md) · [Palette and content guide](../../STUDIO-MODELS.md)

```latex
\studiosetup{palette=light}
\studiotemplate[variant=default]{partner-media-grid}
```

Palette switches are available only where the original composition exists in both colours.
Unsupported explicit choices fail. A global palette leaves special compositions in their native treatment.

## Variants and named fields

Preconfigured sponsor content from the supplied reference. Routine use needs only `\studiotemplate{partner-media-grid}`; fields below are optional for deliberate updates. See [paired sponsor presets](../../STUDIO-SPONSORS.md).

Editable icons: `icon-left-sponsors` / `image-left-sponsors` / `graphic-left-sponsors`, `icon-right-sponsors` / `image-right-sponsors` / `graphic-right-sponsors`, `icon-media` / `image-media` / `graphic-media`. These semantic keys select the icon artwork, preserving the panels. See the full slot guide for position and bounds.

Omitted fields retain these descriptive defaults; empty values retain their allocated space. Numbers and charts are illustrative.

## Complete one-slide example

```latex
\documentclass[aspectratio=169]{beamer}
\usetheme{bitpolito-studio}
\usepackage{bitpolitostudiotemplates}
\usepackage[backend=biber]{biblatex}
\addbibresource{bibliography.bib}
\begin{document}
\studiotemplate[
  variant={default},
  palette={light},
  title={Partners, Sponsors \& Media}
]{partner-media-grid}
\end{document}
```
